授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This class teaches the fundamental principles of thermodynamics from the perspective of the chemistry student. The student will sequentially learn the properties of perfect gas, real gas, first, second, third, and zeroth laws of thermodynamics, properties of gas and liquid mixtures, phase diagrams and chemical equilibrium. We will derive the meaning of the absolute temperature scale and discuss realistic examples for liquid mixtures and phase diagrams. Finally, we will learn to apply the principles of chemical equilibrium on various interesting real chemical processes.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: The class will have a midterm and final exams. The midterm exam will provide 50% of the final grade and the final exam will provide 50% of the final grade. During the class homeworks will be given to solve practical problems discussed in the lectures. The homeworks are mandatory.
